Market today: The tech and AI narrative is strong, driven by big investments and revenue growth in AI. However, rising bond yields and a shift towards defensive stocks suggest underlying market caution.

Your holdings: SOXL (-40.46%) and SPAL (-34.04%) are deep in the red. Both are leveraged ETFs, which decay and amplify losses, especially on margin. SPAL is a brand-new, very volatile IPO.

Watch: Keep an eye on continued AI infrastructure spending and how broader market sentiment (like bond yields) impacts growth stocks.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions aggressively while selectively capitalizing on strong AI/chip momentum.
plays: SOXL and SPAL are leveraged and deeply negative. Consider trimming or exiting these positions to reduce significant margin risk and stop further decay.
Nvidia's backing of OpenAI is a strong catalyst. Consider adding to NVDA at scanner entry 224.78-224.56, stop 224.22, given its ACCUMULATE signal.
ZS shows a strong ACCUMULATE signal (9/12) with daily/4H/1H up bias. Consider ZS at entry 184.26-184.07, stop 183.65, for tech exposure.
